text: Security is a crucial part of web development that every developer should take seriously. First, websites should always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, protecting sensitive information from attackers. Second, strong authentication systems, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, help ensure that only authorised users can access accounts. Third, developers must validate all user input to prevent malicious code from being injected into the system. Common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting often result from weak input handling. By addressing these issues early, developers can build safer applications and protect both their users and their data.
